bureau: מאגר נתוני אשראי (the Bank of Israel credit data register) and the credit bureaus
note: The Bank of Israel's directive on keeping information for the credit data register, 13.4.5: arrears under 100 shekels, or before 30 days from the payment's expected date, aren't reported, written as 30 days. The Credit Data Law, 2016, section 23(a), as the government's consolidated copy has it: the register keeps information ten years, but after three years from its transfer only as documentation, written as three years. Press reports of a 2026 amendment cutting negative data to one year weren't checked against its text, the Knesset's site answering that it's unavailable from this location. The Hebrew PDFs were checked against their extracted text with the direction marks removed (the extraction reverses some digits, as in 6102 for 2016).
